notes.title: 2.3.11/2.3.12 Patch
notes.notes:

notes.title: 2.3.10 Patch
notes.notes:
[h3]Changes[/h3]
• Increased arrival frequency of groups of survivors later in the game
• Easy mode: swapped [i]Beginning of the End[/i] (more outsiders) for [i]Fragile Zombies[/i] (weaker zombies)

notes.title: 2.3.7 Patch (launch version)
notes.notes:
Changes
[list]
[*] Moved Radio Tower below the Mine and Stone Store in the construction menu
[*] Fine tuned scroll sensitivity in construction, crafting, and skill menus
[*] Difficulty-mode modifier stamps are now shown in completed Outposts in the map
[/list]

Fixes
[list]
[*] Improved citizen path following accuracy when experiencing low framerates on higher game speeds
[*] Fixed issue where input shortcuts can be used during the driving caravan sequence
[*] Fixed issue where input shortcuts can be used during the game over sequence
[*] Fixed issue where the camera could still be controlled in some cases during the driving caravan sequence
[*] Fixed day 70+ trading period being used instead of 100+ trading period
[*] Fixed typos in German localisation

notes.title: 2.3.6 Patch
notes.notes:
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Requirement for the Collector achievement is now to collect all stamps (not to complete an Outpost with them)
[*] Requirement for the Completionist achievement is now to have completed an Outpost with all stamps on any difficulty (not to complete all in Hardcore)
[*] Added an error message in the main menu for any future save migration issues
[*] Improved gamepad navigation of the main menu save panels
[*] Reduced number of leaderboard entries shown in the game over screens
[*] When in the 'Friends' leaderboard the friend rank is now displayed rather than the global rank
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed resource drop-off indicators on the right side of the base merging with those on the left
[*] Back button is no longer hidden behind the credits in the main menu on devices with narrower aspect ratios
[*] Fixed a case where fast-forward mode could get stuck at maximum if using the shortcut at the same time as using the mouse
[*] Fixed scrollable menus starting from the bottom with gamepad
[*] Fixed gamepad leaderboard navigation in the game over screens
[*] Improved movement latency of the gamepad selection outline on lower framerates
[/list]

notes.title: 2.3.4/2.3.5 Patch
notes.notes:
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Slightly reduced the volume of Forge and Blacksmith sound effects
[*] Reduced conductivity of the level 1 Radio Tower to 15% (from 50%) and level 2 to 50% (from 80%)
[*] Added fade in/out animation to the stamp info card when hovering over stamps
[*] Leaderboard scores are now submitted every time the game saves
[*] When no knife fighters are assigned to a wall being attacked by zombies, warnings now only appear if there are no guards or snipers
[*] Added battery Motorhome part to replace second wheel part
[*] Switched some input shortcuts to perform their action on release, rather than on press, to be consistent with other shortcuts
[*] The game now pauses when a gamepad is disconnected
[*] The game now pauses when the Steam overlay is activated
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed inability of snipers to shoot a zombie when another sniper has been unassigned or dies while targeting that zombie
[*] Fixed incorrect animation in the stamp completion screen where lower difficulty stickers replaced higher difficulty ones
[*] Fixed stamp completion screen still occasionally appearing even when there are no new completed stamps
[*] Fixed rare case where the high-level trader would appear with an empty slot
[*] Prevented interaction with different menu tabs during the defence menu tutorial tip
[*] Removed the occasional ability to close the defence menu during the defence menu tutorial tip
[*] Fixed starvation notifications not stacking
[*] Fixed cases where the tutorial could get stuck due to scrolling in some menus
[*] Removed the level 3 Forge light due to rare crash
[*] Fixed save migration from version 2.0
[*] Fixed inconsistent gamepad navigation in the save slots panel in the main menu
[*] Fixed issues with fast forward behaviour on gamepad when using hold-down mode
[*] The correct score is now always submitted to the leaderboards upon repairing the caravan
[*] Fixed rare case of stamp info card getting stuck open on gamepad
[*] Right-click can no longer be used to press UI buttons
[/list]

notes.title: Popular mobile game Final Outpost: Definitive Edition arrives gets a PC release on May 22
notes.notes:
Final Outpost: Definitive Edition from Exabyte Games is the expanded and upgraded version of their popular mobile game. They've now announced the full PC release with Native Linux support will arrive on May 22nd.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/04/popular-mobile-game-final-outpost-definitive-edition-arrives-gets-a-pc-release-on-may-22/

notes.title: 2.3.0 Update
notes.notes:
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] The map is now discovered during the game rather than starting out with it
[*] Removed map button from bottom bar, added Outpost stats button to the bottom bar
[*] Added more general Outpost information to the stats menu
[*] Added map and info buttons to the Motorhome menu
[*] Added back the fast-forward mode “hold”, with “toggle” as an option in the settings
[*] Fade to black before the Outpost naming and modifier selection screens in the map
[*] Added sound effect for when outsiders arrive at the Outpost
[*] Changed rating of the “Tougher Zombies” modifier to -2 (from -1)
[*] Hardcore difficulty now saves after every completed Outpost
[*] Reduced Radio Tower level 2 requirement to Base level 6 (from 7)
[*] The trader slot for a Motorhome part is now deactivated once it is purchased
[*] Citizens dropping off resources already at maximum capacity create a new +0 indicator instead of adding to an existing non-zero indicator
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed gamepad menu button not closing the pause menu
[*] Fixed an issue where farms could not be harvested
[*] Fixed chosen difficulty mode not being applied in some cases
[*] Fixed an issue where difficulty modifiers were occasionally duplicated
[*] The assign-mode button in the job menu no longer gets stuck down when closing the menu before releasing the shift key shortcut
[*] Fixed Trader sometimes offering only three deals
[*] Removed some visual glitches on resource indicators
[/list]

notes.title: 2.2.1 Patch
notes.notes:
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Buffed [i]Busier Forests[/i] (more deer) modifier to increase animal population to 20 (from 18)
[*] Swapped [i]Fragile Zombies[/i] (weaker zombies) modifier for the [i]Beginning of the End[/i] (more outsiders) modifier in Easy difficulty
[*] Reduced the trader price of the Motorhome parts (by 100 gold per part on average)
[*] Increased the duration range of all weather events to 5-48h (from 3-48h)
[*] Introduced an overriding duration range for droughts of 12-72h
[*] Reduced volume and added random pitch variation to the citizen death sound effect to make it less likely to be annoying when played repeatedly
[*] Buffed scavenger inventory size in late-game skills
[*] Added Motorhome menu art and animations
[*] Added modifier complete screen animations
[*] Allowed interaction through the skill point gain animation
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the tutorial tips toggle setting not being applied sometimes
[/list]

notes.title: 2.2.0 Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132884/c6db590dc2d923bf0049cf5969758555d99e1edb.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132884/813d3349847d79f5cd54f1f9813cfe9ca7909eba.png[/img]


[h3]New[/h3]
[list]
[*] Repair the motorhome to drive away and settle new Outposts!
[*] Choose your route carefully through the new procedurally-generated map where each location will present you with a new challenge!
[*] Collect stamps from challenges you complete with the new stamp book!
[*] New “Regions Cleared” global leaderboard and 10 new achievements!
[*] New dynamic combat music!
[/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased game speed controls to x1, x5, and x10 (from x1, x3, x7.5)
[*] Added ability to toggle between all speeds rather than holding down for max speed
[*] Increased baseline probability of droughts
[*] Increased the probability that lightning hits a building when it strikes
[*] Increased sniper damage to 60 (from 50)
[*] Barbed wire walls do 3x more damage to zombies
[*] Added an indicator for barbed wire in the wall upgrade menu
[*] Added ammo information to the turret upgrade menu
[*] The Radio Tower no longer conducts every lightning strike, but its conductivity improves at higher levels
[*] Added details on effects of the Radio Tower to its inspector menu
[*] Reduced base level required for Radio Tower level 1 and 2
[*] Changed cost of building Radio Tower to 50 scrap
[*] Increased the build time of the Radio Tower to 60s (from 30s)
[*] Tweaked zombie death animation
[*] Improved shadows on in-world motorhome
[*] Rain and snow particle effects are now affected less by increased game speed
[*] Removed mist effect over the forest
[*] Tweaked the time between ambient music tracks in-game
[*] Added an option to change whether or not the game runs in the background
[*] Added an option to disable/enable button glyphs
[*] You can now choose whether to enable tutorial tips when creating a new save slot
[*] Improved leaderboards menu
[*] Improved main menu save panel
[*] Improved game over summary screen
[*] Improved save slot creation menu
[*] Added a return button to more menus
[*] Switched around gamepad controls for zooming in and out
[*] Improved UI scrolling, particularly for trackpads
[*] Removed demo score system and “Score” leaderboard
[*] New translations are temporary and will be professionally translated before full release
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Substantial performance improvements during combat and for in-world UI popups
[*] Fixed zombie noise sensitivity values not being applied correctly
[*] Fixed issue with forest UI animations at higher game speeds
[*] Improved notification animations at higher game speeds
[*] Fixed “Reset Statistics” button not applying the reset until next time the current Outpost saves
[*] Fixed imperfections on the moon artwork in the main menu
[*] Fixed occasional issue with scrolling in the construction menu with gamepad
[/list]
